Zalando - 2024: KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Berlin (prior year auditor: EY GmbH & Co. KG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Stuttgart)
Delivery Hero - 2024: KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Berlin

Yes, both companies used the same auditor, KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Berlin, for their 2024 financial statements. For Zalando, KPMG was new in 2024 (replacing EY due to legal rotation requirements); the evidence does not state whether KPMG was new for Delivery Hero in 2024.
